text: Being here, I feel slightly disoriented but curious. The repeated 'Mm-hmm' sound in my ear makes the space seem both mechanical and reassuring, as if someone is quietly acknowledging my presence or ideas. The tilted, glass-walled environment and bright colors signal innovation and experimentation, inviting me to question what it means to research or develop. I sense anticipation—as though something new waits to be discovered in the mundane hum of agreement.
